lead: Calcium and vitamin supplement for reptiles. Supports proper bone development - dust it over food.

description.html: A combined calcium and vitamin supplement for the daily diet of reptiles. Calcium is essential for proper bone development and strength, while the vitamin part of the formula supports overall metabolism, immunity and skin health.

Dust the supplement over live or supplementary food right before feeding. Regular use reduces the risk of metabolic bone disease (MBD), one of the most common diseases in captive reptiles. For best results, use it with adequate UVB lighting, which enables the synthesis of the vitamin D3 needed for calcium absorption.
Suitable for all kinds of lizards, snakes and other reptiles that need supplementary minerals and vitamins.
